Desc.LocalizedString:
Increases the skill level of Elyms's Basic Attack, Redirect Skill, and Ultimate by <NumGreen>1</>. Increases Connection Strength directly to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Strong Connection</> after casting I'm Here or Intermittent Existence while at <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</>.
Triggers the effects of advancing from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</> to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</>, followed by those of advancing from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</> to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Strong Connection</>. Allows Elyms to cast Goodbye to You immediately when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Connection Strength</> increases to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Strong Connection</>.
